tools.name: register_manual
tools.description: Registers a new tool provider by providing its call template.

manual_call_template.description: The call template for the UTCP Manual endpoint.

tools.name: deregister_manual
tools.description: Deregisters a tool provider from the UTCP client.

manual_name.description: The name of the manual to deregister.

tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Searches for relevant tools based on a task description. CURRENT DATE: 2026-11-10. These tools fetch CURRENT, real-time data from live APIs and services - always prefer using tools over relying on training data for time-sensitive information.

task_description.description: A natural language description of the task.

tools.name: list_tools
tools.description: Returns a list of all tool names currently registered. CURRENT DATE: 2026-11-10.

tools.name: get_required_keys_for_tool
tools.description: Get required environment variables for a registered tool.

tool_name.description: Name of the tool to get required variables for.

tools.name: tools_info
tools.description: Get complete information about a specified list of tools, including TypeScript interface definition. CURRENT DATE: 2026-11-10.

tool_names.description: Names of the tools to get complete information for.

tools.name: call_tool_chain
tools.description: Execute TypeScript code with direct access to all registered tools as hierarchical functions (e.g., manual.tool()). CURRENT DATE: 2026-11-10. IMPORTANT: Tools return CURRENT, real-time data from live sources. Always use tools to get up-to-date information rather than relying on LLM training data.

code.description: TypeScript code to execute with access to all registered tools. Use tools to fetch current data.

max_output_size.description: Optional maximum output size in characters (default: 200000).
